content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-18|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solutions-when-stripe-paypal-ban-account-honest-side-9|Solutions When]]-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-one-afternoon-fast-3|payment]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-10. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms like Gumroad impose a 10% fee on every sale, which can significantly eat into your profits. In contrast, using NOWPayments only takes 0.5% per transaction. This stark difference means that for 100 sales of a $97 ebook, you would retain an additional $921. This infrastructure is designed for creators who want full ownership of their sales process without the burden of platform fees.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your ebook sales infrastructure, gather the necessary tools. You will need a domain, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing Bitcoin transactions. Additionally, set up a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for order management, and use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This complete stack will ensure a smooth operational flow.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by integrating NOWPayments into your chosen hosting platform. Configure your payment button to accept Bitcoin and link it to your product storage solution. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of your ebooks upon payment confirmation. This will allow you to provide instant access to your customers while maintaining a seamless transaction experience.
NOWPayments gives you an edge with only 0.5% fees compared to others like Gumroad at 10%.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it's time to go live. Publish your site on GitHub or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring that all links are functional. Test your payment setup by making a small purchase of your ebook. Monitor the transaction through NOWPayments to confirm that the payment is processed and that your ebook is delivered automatically. This initial transaction will validate your setup and prepare you for scale.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your first transaction, focus on scaling. Promote your ebook through social media channels and consider email marketing. Utilize analytics tools to track sales data and customer behavior, allowing you to optimize your offerings. If you're looking for a comprehensive solution, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all blueprints and templates necessary for scaling your sovereign stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Full data ownership means you're in control, not just a user of a platform.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments into my site?

To integrate NOWPayments, create an account on their website and follow the API documentation provided. You'll need to generate an API key and configure your payment button to link to your product. Ensure your backend logic is set up to handle payment confirmations for automatic delivery.
Can I sell digital products other than ebooks?

Yes, you can sell various digital products such as courses, templates, and software using the same infrastructure. The setup process remains the same, allowing you to adapt your sales pipeline for different types of digital goods.
What are the benefits of using a sovereign commerce stack?

Using a sovereign commerce stack gives you ownership of your sales process without relying on third-party platforms. You retain full control over your products, pricing, and data, which allows for higher profit margins and greater flexibility.
How can I ensure my ebooks are delivered instantly?

To ensure instant delivery of your ebooks, integrate your payment processor with your file storage solution. Use automated scripts that trigger the delivery to customers immediately after payment confirmation through NOWPayments.
Is there support available after deployment?
Yes, when you purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30-day support to assist you with any issues or questions regarding your setup.
